steps.name: explore
steps.probe: (async()=>{const p=goldBoxPlus,i=await import('/engine/input.js'),h=(await import('/plus/hooks.js')).hooks;const before=document.getElementById('screen').toDataURL();p.open();p.selectTab('journal');await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,400));if(document.getElementById('screen').toDataURL()!==before)throw Error('open canvas');i.script.keys=[[0,0x48]];const keys=JSON.stringify(i.script.keys);await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,700));if(JSON.stringify(i.script.keys)!==keys||i.KeyPressed())throw Error('script consumed while open');i.script.keys=[];p.close();if(document.getElementById('screen').toDataURL()!==before)throw Error('close canvas');await p.setSetting('original',true);if(h.enabled)throw Error('master off failed');await p.setSetting('original',false);if(!h.enabled)throw Error('master on failed');return {pass:true,canvasUnchanged:true,inputPaused:true,masterSwitch:true};})()
